concepts.def: Country specialises where opportunity cost is lower; trade mutually beneficial (Ricardo 1817).
Countries export goods using their abundant factors intensively (Heckscher 1919; Ohlin 1933).
Tax on imports; raises domestic price, reduces consumer surplus, deadweight loss in small open economy.
Quantitative limit on imports; raises price; revenue accrues to license holders, not government.
Established 1995, successor to GATT 1947; multilateral rules and dispute settlement among 164 members.
Sequence of retaliatory protectionist measures; US-China tariffs from 2018 most prominent recent case.
